title: Household Relationship Rate Courtesy — Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing
content:
*Rate courtesy note — household business.*

The household's other Ridgeline business adjusts the annual rate of monthly interest on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion: a closed entry or patio door contract paid by cash, check or card takes the door-customer rate courtesy of 0.25% off; otherwise an active CareLine service plan takes the CareLine rate courtesy of 0.125% off; otherwise it is left.

A CareLine service plan here means a CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate plan in active status; an On-Call Service Account is not a CareLine plan. The door contract is read from the customer's Entry & Patio Door Contracts records (payment method and status) and the plan from the customer's CareLine Service Plans records. The courtesy is taken off the purchase APR in arriving at the annual rate, which never falls below zero.

| Closed door contract paid by cash, check or card | Active CareLine plan | Annual rate courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Less 0.25% |
| Yes | No | Less 0.25% |
| No | Yes | Less 0.125% |
| No | No | No change |

## Points of judgement

- A door contract paid through Ridgeline financing, or a cash-paid door contract not yet closed, is not a closed cash-paid door contract.
- A CareLine plan past due, cancelled or expired is not active; an On-Call Service Account never counts.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Purchase APR 10.00%, no closed door contract, an active CareLine Premier Plan, nothing else changing the rate: 9.875%.
